subject: Social Media
title: Internet Memes Evolve
description: A micro-lesson that makes Internet Memes Evolve usable.

hook.text: The same Drake meme has been reused millions of times with different text. The template survives.

buildup.text: Internet memes follow evolutionary rules: they mutate with each share, and only the funniest survive.

discovery.text: Limor Shifman studied meme evolution and found three traits: simplicity, humor, and easy remixability.

twist.text: The most viral memes are never the original. They're the best remix—iteration beats invention.

climax.text: Meme culture mirrors natural selection. Bad mutations die instantly. Good ones spread in hours.

punchline.text: The fittest meme survives. Darwin would approve.

quiz.question: What three traits make memes spread according to Limor Shifman?
